observations: Guardian danger candidate desktop at ~53–55s records genuine HP 4/8→3/8→1/8 and HP-linked gate opening, but visible video mostly frames a large background gear and the hero/small enemy; the bronze gate/counterweights are not immediately apparent in these samples.

Guardian danger candidate portrait at ~85–87s records HP 6/8→4/8→2/8, but the sample shows mainly the hero against a vertical tower wall while the guardian and capstan are outside the mobile crop. That means the most interesting new mechanics may happen outside viewer attention.

Matched-seed baseline and candidate at the same seconds commonly depict DIFFERENT floors/runs/action (e.g. desktop 60s: baseline ongoing floor 8, candidate an outcome at floor 13); observation matching by game-state requires work. Recording-length and seed alone do not certify a fair blind AB comparison.
